validatedNames.name: Krishna
validatedNames.role: The Supreme Personality of Godhead, central deity and protagonist of the Bhagavatam

validatedNames.name: Brahmaji
validatedNames.role: The creator deity (Brahma), born from the lotus navel of Vishnu, first created being

validatedNames.name: Kali
validatedNames.role: The personification of the current age of Kali, depicted as a degraded being confronted by Maharaj Parikshit

validatedNames.name: Maharaj Parikshit
validatedNames.role: The cursed king who listened to the Bhagavatam for seven days before his death from a snakebite

validatedNames.name: Vyasadeva
validatedNames.role: The sage-compiler of the Bhagavatam, son of Parashara, literary incarnation of Vishnu

validatedNames.name: Narad
validatedNames.role: The divine sage and devotee who travels the universe glorifying Vishnu and instructing others in bhakti

validatedNames.name: Bhishmadev
validatedNames.role: The grandsire of the Kurus who recited the glories of Vishnu on his deathbed at Kurukshetra

validatedNames.name: Pandavas
validatedNames.role: The five sons of Pandu including Arjuna, devotees of Krishna and heroes of the Kurukshetra war

validatedNames.name: Shukdev
validatedNames.role: The liberated sage and son of Vyasadeva who narrated the Bhagavatam to Maharaj Parikshit

validatedNames.name: Arjun
validatedNames.role: The great archer and devotee of Krishna, recipient of the Bhagavad Gita on the battlefield of Kurukshetra

validatedNames.name: Narayan
validatedNames.role: The Supreme Lord Vishnu-Narayana, the source of all creation and ultimate refuge of all living beings

validatedNames.name: Suta
validatedNames.role: The narrator Suta Goswami who retold the Bhagavatam to sages assembled at Naimisharanya

validatedNames.name: Lord Krishna
validatedNames.role: Supreme deity and central figure of the Bhagavatam, avatar of Vishnu

validatedNames.name: Vidur
validatedNames.role: Uncle of the Pandavas and Kauravas, devotee who received teachings from Maitreya

validatedNames.name: Maitreya
validatedNames.role: Sage and narrator who imparts spiritual knowledge to Vidura

validatedNames.name: Chaitanya
validatedNames.role: Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, saint and devotee regarded as avatar of Krishna in the Bhagavatam tradition

validatedNames.name: Manu
validatedNames.role: Progenitor of mankind and lawgiver, several Manus appear across cosmic time cycles in the Bhagavatam

validatedNames.name: Yudhishthir
validatedNames.role: Eldest Pandava prince and righteous king whose questions frame portions of the Bhagavatam narrative

validatedNames.name: Shri Krishna
validatedNames.role: Supreme deity and central figure of the Bhagavatam, avatar of Vishnu

validatedNames.name: Kardam
validatedNames.role: Prajapati and sage who married Devahuti and fathered Kapila Muni

validatedNames.name: Daksha
validatedNames.role: Progenitor and patriarch, son of Brahma, whose yajna was destroyed by Shiva

validatedNames.name: Sati
validatedNames.role: Daughter of Daksha and first wife of Shiva, who immolated herself at her father's yajna

validatedNames.name: Kapil
validatedNames.role: Divine sage and son of Devahuti, founder of Sankhya philosophy, an incarnation of Vishnu
